subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` header make OpenAI-compatible request body `model` values advisory/ignored for agent selection, or should the documented agent-first body model contract remain strict?
rationale: The requested behavior improves generic OpenAI SDK compatibility but changes the documented Gateway HTTP model contract and affects shared Chat Completions/Responses routing semantics.

options.title: Adopt shared header precedence
options.body: When a valid agent header is present, treat body `model` as compatibility metadata across the shared OpenAI-compatible paths and update tests/docs accordingly.

options.title: Keep strict agent-first model
options.body: Preserve the current contract and tell clients to use `openclaw`, `openclaw/<agentId>`, or omit `model` when selecting by header.

options.title: Add an explicit compatibility mode
options.body: Add an opt-in mode only if maintainers want OpenAI SDK compatibility without changing existing default semantics, accepting the extra config/API surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared header precedence
recommendation.body: When a valid agent header is present, treat body `model` as compatibility metadata across the shared OpenAI-compatible paths and update tests/docs accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the current agent-first contract and is the clearest owner for deciding whether to relax it.
